امتريا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَرَيَا (imtarayā) /im.ta.ra.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# اُمْتُرِيَا (umturiyā) /um.tu.ri.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
# اِمْتَرِيَا (imtariyā) /im.ta.ri.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِمْتَرَى (imtarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
